Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: mdca.cloud_discovery.apps
Metrics.Description: Cloud Discovery apps discovered from uploaded traffic logs in the trailing 30 days, by category.

Metrics.Name: mdca.cloud_discovery.apps.by_risk
Metrics.Description: Cloud Discovery apps discovered in the trailing 30 days, by risk band (this collector's own low/medium/high/critical banding of riskScore).

Metrics.Name: mdca.cloud_discovery.apps_truncated
Metrics.Description: Count of Cloud Discovery upload streams whose discovered-app list hit the per-poll cap. Non-zero means some discovered apps for that stream were not processed this cycle.

Metrics.Name: mdca.cloud_discovery.log_files.total
Metrics.Description: Sum of logFileCount across every Cloud Discovery upload stream. Unlabeled: a per-stream figure would key a series by stream identity, which grows with tenant configuration.

Metrics.Name: mdca.cloud_discovery.streams
Metrics.Description: Cloud Discovery upload streams configured for the tenant, by whether the stream is a one-off snapshot report.
